checks.name: globe-controls-responsive
checks.evidence: Zoom-in via globe-zoom-in moved camera correctly (delta>0). BUG: after clicking globe-auto-rotate, camera position sampled every 300ms over 3s was byte-identical across all 10 samples (e.g. [1.6317836393266543,1.0352886160531387,-2.6749690906432235] repeated 10x) -- zero sustained motion. Reproduced on rerun (not flaky). Root cause: CameraRig's useFrame in EarthGlobe.tsx only calls invalidate() when a destination lerp is active; with Canvas frameloop="demand" and no destination set, OrbitControls.autoRotate's per-frame angle update never triggers a re-render, so the canvas freezes after the one frame produced by the click's own re-render.

bugs.description: Toggling auto-rotate ON produces no sustained camera motion (frontend-only rendering bug, pre-existing CameraRig logic unrelated to this task's diff but exercised by this task's acceptance criterion). Zoom-in/out and reset work correctly.
bugs.evidence: Browser check 'globe-controls-responsive': 10 camera-position samples taken at 300ms intervals over 3s after clicking globe-auto-rotate were all identical: [1.6317836393266543,1.0352886160531387,-2.6749690906432235] (repeated). Cross-check: backend /api/environment and /api/data/positions both return 200 (healthy), confirming this is a frontend rendering-loop issue, not a data/API problem. Code inspection: frontend/src/components/EarthGlobe.tsx CameraRig's useFrame only calls invalidate() inside the `if(destination.current)` branch; the auto-rotate-only path (no destination) never re-invalidates the Canvas which uses frameloop="demand", so no further frames render after the single frame triggered by the button click's own React re-render.

action_items.detail: Pre-existing backend test tests/test_tscheck_catalog_pagination_search.py::test_objects_pagination_reconciles_with_summary_totals fails (asserts len(objects)<=40 but API returns 50 for page_size=40 param, which the API does not use -- catalog endpoint uses `limit`, not `page_size`). This file predates this iteration's acceptance_matrix (it is not one of the 8 Earth3D criteria) and was not modified by this task; flagged for visibility only, not scored against this iteration's checks.

Fix CameraRig's frameloop invalidation so autoRotate produces continuous motion under Canvas frameloop="demand" (e.g. call invalidate() unconditionally each frame while auto is true, or switch to frameloop="always" while autoRotate is active).
